content: Figure FIGREF50 shows CE distribution and prediction accuracy. For the four basic markers fatHa, kasra, damma and sukun, which appear 18%, 14%, 13% and 8% respectively, the system has CEER $\sim $0.5% for each. Again, detecting the virtual CE mark was a fairly easy task. All other CE markers representing 20% have negligible errors.
